  "agent": "The United States Senate",

  "situation": "The Senate is considering Senate Resolution 400 after a committee investigation found congressional awareness of the Agency had been extremely limited and that this allowed abuses to occur. The investigating committee recommended a permanent Senate select committee to oversee the CIA and the rest of the Intelligence Community. The proposed resolution would give the new committee exclusive oversight of the CIA and concurrent jurisdiction over other intelligence activities. It would also establish annual authorization responsibilities, while excluding certain tactical foreign military intelligence activities from that authority. The proposal includes rules for membership, tenure, minority access, and a unified professional staff.",
  "question": "What should the United States Senate do about Senate Resolution 400?",
